- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Encouraged Trade and Industry: She promoted the development of native industries and lowered tariffs on certain goods to make them more affordable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reformed Agriculture: She implemented agricultural reforms that improved productivity and output.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Education Reforms: She introduced reforms aimed at improving education levels among the common people to create a skilled workforce.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Population Growth: She encouraged population growth to create a larger domestic market, increasing demand for goods and services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These measures helped modernize the Austrian economy, create a more equitable society, and promote economic growth.
